verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev automations are TypeScript code, so they can be versioned and reviewed through normal git and IDE workflows (GitHub Actions deploy on push to main; a user reports managing workflows in the IDE instead of a GUI). The platform also has deployment versioning: each run is locked to the latest code version at start and stays on it across later deploys. However, nothing in the pack documents rolling back or promoting a previous deployed version, and review is only implied by git-based deployment, not shown as a platform feature. Missing for 10: documented rollback/promote-previous-version capability, platform-level version history or diff review, independent hands-on corroboration of version management.
